WITH tc AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    cnt,
    CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / SUM(cnt) OVER () as share
  FROM tc
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    cnt,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () as diff
  FROM shares
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    cnt,
    share,
    diff,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) as rn
  FROM with_avg
),
tenth AS (
  SELECT diff FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10 LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  cnt as telescope_count,
  share,
  diff as difference
FROM ranked
WHERE rn < 10 OR diff IN (SELECT * FROM tenth)
ORDER BY diff DESC, observstation
